name: Zork
description: Full MIT 1977 dungeon from dung.56; original prose delivered via radio multipart.
welcome: You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded front door.
help: DM `new game` to start. Try: look, n/s/e/w, open, take, inventory, examine, light, move, attack, put, help, ?. `1/3…` = more coming, wait · `.3/3` = done. ⏱️ means act soon.

dark.message: It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.
dark.timer_message: Oh no! A lurking grue gobbles you up.

troll.name: troll
troll.here: A nasty-looking troll blocks the way, axe in hand.

cyclo.name: cyclops
cyclo.here: A cyclops, who looks prepared to eat horses, blocks the staircase.

thief.name: thief
thief.here: A seedy-looking gentleman with a large bag watches you closely.

system_messages.busy: The way down is barred: a storm of voices fills the air above. I will call you when it quiets.
system_messages.paused: A storm of voices rises above the dungeon. Your lamp gutters while you wait. I will call when it quiets.
system_messages.resume: The air is still again. The dungeon awaits your next move.
system_messages.wait_turn: Another adventurer already walks these halls. You wait at the gate; I will call when the way is clear.
system_messages.offer: The way is open to you. Answer within {mins} minute{s} with any command (or `new game`), or it closes again.
system_messages.banned: The dungeon is closed to you.
system_messages.queue_full: Too many lanterns crowd the entrance. Return later.
